scope: Corollary 7.2 (Soundness) of the manuscript “The Factor-Two Hardness Threshold for Vertex Cover” (preprints/The-Factor-Two-Hardness-Threshold-for-Vertex-Cover-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 102 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4c8faec31a1af3d0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the graph constructed in Section 3, assume (6.2). If val(Φ) ≤ σ, every independent set has size strictly less than n/m. Consequently τ(G) > (1 − 1/m)n.
